description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller providing several endpoints: a welcome message, a redirect to Swagger UI documentation, a health check, and application info. It uses annotations to specify request mappings and API documentation, and constructs redirect URLs dynamically based on incoming requests.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller handling basic endpoints for notes backend, including welcome, documentation redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Constructs a URL to the Swagger UI page from the incoming request and redirects the client to that URL.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating application health.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a string with basic information about the application.
